questions.text: जब किसी परखनली में दानेदार जिंक के कुछ टुकड़ों में 2 mL सोडियम हाइड्रॉक्साइड विलयन मिलाकर उसे गर्म किया जाता है, तो होने वाली रासायनिक अभिक्रिया को संतुलित रासायनिक समीकरण के रूप में इस प्रकार लिखा जा सकता है :
questions.text_english: When 2 mL of sodium hydroxide solution is added to few pieces of granulated zinc in a test tube and then warmed, the reaction that occurs can be written in the form of a balanced chemical equation as :
questions.solution: Zinc reacts with sodium hydroxide to form sodium zincate and hydrogen gas. The balanced chemical equation is 2NaOH + Zn → Na2ZnO2 + H2.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से एक वियोजन (अपघटन) अभिक्रिया चुनिए जिसमें वियोजन के लिए ऊर्जा का स्रोत प्रकाश हो :
questions.text_english: Select from the following a decomposition reaction in which source of energy for decomposition is light :
questions.solution: The decomposition of silver bromide (AgBr) into silver and bromine occurs in the presence of sunlight. This is a photochemical decomposition reaction.

questions.text: कक्ष ताप पर द्रव अवस्था में पायी जाने वाली एक धातु और एक अधातु क्रमशः हैं :
questions.text_english: A metal and a non-metal that exists in liquid state at the room temperature are respectively:
questions.solution: Mercury is a metal that is liquid at room temperature, and Bromine is a non-metal that is liquid at room temperature.

questions.text: कार्बन के यौगिक / यौगिकों : (i) विद्युत के सुचालक होते हैं। (ii) विद्युत के कुचालक होते हैं। (iii) के अणुओं के बीच प्रबल आकर्षण बल होता है। (iv) के अणुओं के बीच दुर्बल आकर्षण बल होता है। इनमें सही कथन हैं :
questions.text_english: Carbon compounds: (i) are good conductors of electricity. (ii) are bad conductors of electricity. (iii) have strong forces of attraction between their molecules. (iv) have weak forces of attraction between their molecules. The correct statements are:
questions.solution: Carbon compounds are generally covalent. They do not form ions, hence they are bad conductors of electricity. Covalent molecules have weak intermolecular forces of attraction.

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए यौगिकों पर विचार कीजिए : FeSO4; CuSO4; CaSO4; Na2CO3. इनमें से किस यौगिक के क्रिस्टलीय रूप में एक अणु में क्रिस्टलन जल के अणुओं की संख्या अधिकतम है ?
questions.text_english: Consider the following compounds : FeSO4; CuSO4; CaSO4; Na2CO3. The compound having maximum number of water of crystallisation in its crystalline form in one molecule is:
questions.solution: Sodium carbonate decahydrate (washing soda) has the formula Na2CO3·10H2O, which contains 10 molecules of water of crystallization, the maximum among the given options.

questions.text: ऐलुमिनियम और जिंक के ऑक्साइड होते हैं :
questions.text_english: Oxides of aluminium and zinc are:
questions.solution: Oxides of aluminium (Al2O3) and zinc (ZnO) show both acidic and basic behaviours. Such metal oxides are known as amphoteric oxides.

questions.text: MnO2 + 4HCl → MnCl2 + 2H2O + Cl2. उपरोक्त अभिक्रिया रेडॉक्स अभिक्रिया है क्योंकि इसमें :
questions.text_english: MnO2 + 4HCl → MnCl2 + 2H2O + Cl2. The reaction given above is a redox reaction because in this case :

options.A: MnO2 उपचयित और HCl अपचयित हो रहा है।
options.D: MnO2 अपचयित हो रहा है और HCl उपचयित हो रहा है।

options_english.A: MnO2 is oxidised and HCl is reduced.
options_english.D: MnO2 is reduced and HCl is oxidised.

questions.solution: In this reaction, MnO2 loses oxygen and is reduced to MnCl2. HCl loses hydrogen and is oxidized to Cl2.

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए कथनों पर विचार कीजिए: (i) किसी शिशु का लिंग इससे निर्धारित होता है कि उसे माता से क्या वंशानुगत हुआ है। (ii) किसी शिशु का लिंग इससे निर्धारित होता है कि उसे पिता से क्या वंशानुगत हुआ है। (iii) नर शिशु होने की प्रायिकता मादा शिशु होने की प्रायिकता से अधिक होती है। (iv) किसी शिशु का लिंग निर्धारण निषेचन के समय तब होता है जब नर युग्मक और मादा युग्मक के संलयन द्वारा युग्मनज बनता है। इनमें सही कथन हैं :
questions.text_english: Consider the following statements: (i) The sex of a child is determined by what it inherits from the mother. (ii) The sex of a child is determined by what it inherits from the father. (iii) The probability of having a male child is more than that of a female child. (iv) The sex of a child is determined at the time of fertilisation when male and female gametes fuse to form a zygote. The correct statements are:
questions.solution: The sex of a child is determined by the chromosome inherited from the father (X or Y) at the time of fertilization. The probability of male and female child is equal (50%). Hence, (ii) and (iv) are correct.

questions.text: गुणसूत्र : (i) आनुवंशिक सूचना को जनकों से अगली संतति तक ले जाते हैं। (ii) किसी जन्तु कोशिका के केन्द्रक के भीतर धागेनुमा संरचना होती है। (iii) मानव जनन तंत्र में सदैव युग्मों में विद्यमान होते हैं। (iv) कोशिका विभाजन में सम्मिलित होते हैं। इनमें सही कथन हैं :
questions.text_english: Chromosomes: (i) carry hereditary information from parents to the next generation. (ii) are thread like structures located inside the nucleus of an animal cell. (iii) always exist in pairs in human reproductive cells. (iv) are involved in the process of cell division. The correct statements are:
questions.solution: Chromosomes carry hereditary information, are thread-like structures in the nucleus, and participate in cell division. In human reproductive cells (gametes), they exist singly, not in pairs. Thus, (i), (ii), and (iv) are correct.

questions.text: किसी तंत्रिका का वह स्थल जहाँ विद्युत आवेश रासायनिक सिगनल में परिवर्तित होता है उसे कहते हैं :
questions.text_english: In a nerve cell, the site where the electrical impulse is converted into a chemical signal is known as:
questions.solution: At the neuromuscular junction (or synapse at the axonal end), the electrical impulse triggers the release of neurotransmitters, converting it into a chemical signal.

questions.text: रंध्र तब बंद होता है जब : (i) प्रकाश संश्लेषण के लिए कार्बनडाइऑक्साइड की आवश्यकता होती है। (ii) प्रकाश संश्लेषण के लिए कार्बनडाइऑक्साइड की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है। (iii) द्वार कोशिकाओं से पानी बाहर चला जाता है। (iv) द्वार कोशिकाओं में पानी भीतर चला जाता है। इस प्रक्रिया में सही कारण है/हैं :
questions.text_english: A stomata closes when : (i) it needs carbon dioxide for photosynthesis. (ii) it does not need carbon dioxide for photosynthesis. (iii) water flows out of the guard cells. (iv) water flows into the guard cells. The correct reason(s) in this process is/are :
questions.solution: Stomata close to prevent water loss when the plant does not need carbon dioxide for photosynthesis, and the closure is mechanically driven by water flowing out of the guard cells causing them to shrink.

questions.text: किसी बिम्ब को किसी उत्तल लेंस के सामने कितनी दूरी पर रखा जाना चाहिए ताकि पर्दे पर बिम्ब के समान साइज का प्रतिबिम्ब प्राप्त हो ?
questions.text_english: At what distance from a convex lens should an object be placed to get an image of the same size as that of the object on a screen ?

options.A: लेंस की फोकस दूरी की दोगुनी दूरी से अधिक दूरी पर।
options.C: लेंस की फोकस दूरी की दोगुनी दूरी पर।
options.D: लेंस के प्रकाशिक केन्द्र और मुख्य फोकस के बीच।

options_english.A: Beyond twice the focal length of the lens.
options_english.B: At the principal focus of the lens.
options_english.C: At twice the focal length of the lens.
options_english.D: Between the optical centre of the lens and its principal focus.

questions.solution: For a convex lens, to obtain a real image of the same size as the object, the object must be placed at 2F (twice the focal length of the lens).

questions.text: मानव नेत्र का लेंस-निकाय किसी प्रकाश सुग्राही पर्दे पर प्रतिबिम्ब बनाता है जिसे कहते हैं :
questions.text_english: The lens system of human eye forms an image on a light sensitive screen, which is called as:
questions.solution: The retina is the light-sensitive screen at the back of the human eye where the eye lens system forms a real and inverted image.

questions.text: किसी धारावाही परिनालिका के भीतर उत्पन्न चुम्बकीय क्षेत्र का पैटर्न होता है :
questions.text_english: The pattern of the magnetic field produced inside a current carrying solenoid is:
questions.image_description: Four diagrams representing magnetic field lines. Option A should correctly show parallel straight field lines inside the solenoid, indicating a uniform magnetic field.
questions.solution: The magnetic field inside a long straight current-carrying solenoid is uniform. It is represented by parallel straight lines along the axis of the solenoid.
questions.topic: Magnetic Field due to a Solenoid

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से वह आहार श्रृंखला पहचानिए जिसका द्वितीय पोषी स्तर का जीव विलुप्त है :
questions.text_english: Identify the food chain in which the organisms of the second trophic level are missing:

options.B: प्राणिप्लवक, पादपप्लवक, छोटी मछली, बड़ी मछली

options_english.B: Zooplankton, Phytoplankton, small fish, large fish

questions.solution: In the chain 'Tiger, grass, snake, frog', there is no primary consumer (herbivore) that feeds on the grass. The second trophic level is completely missing.

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए किस जीव की अलैंगिक जनन की विधि बहुखण्डन है ?
questions.text_english: In which of the following organisms, multiple fission is a means of asexual reproduction?
questions.solution: Plasmodium, the malarial parasite, divides into many daughter cells simultaneously by multiple fission.

questions.text: अभिकथन (A): जब जिंक नाइट्रिक अम्ल से अभिक्रिया करता है तो हाइड्रोजन गैस नहीं निकलती है। कारण (R) : नाइट्रिक अम्ल अभिक्रिया में उत्पन्न हाइड्रोजन गैस को उपचयित करके पानी बनाता है और स्वयं अपचयित हो जाता है।
questions.text_english: Assertion (A): Hydrogen gas is not evolved when zinc reacts with nitric acid. Reason (R): Nitric acid oxidises the hydrogen gas produced to water and itself gets reduced.
questions.instruction_line: प्रश्न संख्या 17 से 20 में दो कथन एक अभिकथन (A) और दूसरा कारण (R) दिया गया है। इन प्रश्नों के उत्तर नीचे दिए गए कोड (a), (b), (c) और (d) में से चुनकर दीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: For Q. Nos. 17 to 20, two statements are given - One labelled as Assertion (A) and the other labelled as Reason (R). Select the correct answer to these questions from the codes (a), (b), (c) and (d) as given below :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, किंतु कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु कारण (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, किंतु कारण (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Nitric acid is a strong oxidizing agent. It oxidizes the hydrogen produced to water and itself gets reduced to nitrogen oxides. Hence, both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.

questions.text: अभिकथन (A): किसी आहार श्रृंखला के उच्चतम पोषी स्तर के जीवों में हानिकर रसायनों का संग्रहण अधिकतम होता है। कारण (R) : फसलों को रोगों और पीड़कों से बचाने के लिए उन पर हानिकर रसायनों का छिड़काव किया जाता है।
questions.text_english: Assertion (A): Accumulation of harmful chemicals is maximum in the organisms at the highest trophic level of a food chain. Reason (R): Harmful chemicals are sprayed on the crops to protect them from diseases and pests.

options.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion is true due to biological magnification. Reason is also a true statement about the origin of these chemicals. However, the reason does not explain the process of magnification along the chain.

questions.text: अभिकथन (A) : स्थलीय जीवों की तुलना में जलीय जीवों की श्वसन-दर अधिक तीव्र होती है। कारण (R) : वायु में ऑक्सीजन की मात्रा की तुलना में पानी में घुली ऑक्सीजन की मात्रा बहुत अधिक होती है।
questions.text_english: Assertion (A): The rate of breathing in aquatic organisms is much faster than in terrestrial organisms. Reason (R): The amount of oxygen dissolved in water is very high as compared to the amount of oxygen in air.

options.A: Both A and R are true and R is correct explanation.
options.B: Both A and R are true, but R is not correct explanation.
options.C: A is true, but R is false.
options.D: A is false, but R is true.

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The rate of breathing in aquatic organisms is faster because the amount of dissolved oxygen in water is fairly low compared to the amount of oxygen in the air. Thus, A is true but R is false.

questions.text: अभिकथन (A): इन्द्रधनुष आकाश में सूर्य के प्रकाश का प्राकृतिक स्पेक्ट्रम होता है। कारण (R) : इन्द्रधनुष तभी बनता है जब आकाश में सूर्य सिर के ऊपर होता है तथा वायु में जल की सूक्ष्म बूंदें भी उपस्थित होती हैं।
questions.text_english: Assertion (A): The rainbow is a natural spectrum of sunlight in the sky. Reason (R): Rainbow is formed in the sky when the sun is overhead and water droplets are also present in air.

options.A: Both A and R are true and R is correct explanation.
options.B: Both A and R are true, but R is not correct explanation.
options.C: A is true, but R is false.
options.D: A is false, but R is true.

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: A rainbow is always formed in a direction opposite to that of the sun. It cannot be formed when the sun is exactly overhead. Therefore, A is true but R is false.

questions.text: उस रासायनिक अभिक्रिया के प्रकार का नाम लिखिए जिसमें कैल्सियम ऑक्साइड पानी से अभिक्रिया करता है। अपने उत्तर की पुष्टि के लिए रासायनिक अभिक्रिया का संतुलित रासायनिक समीकरण दीजिए।
questions.text_english: Name the type of chemical reaction in which calcium oxide reacts with water. Justify your answer by giving balanced chemical equation for the chemical reaction.

key_points: Combination reaction / Exothermic reaction
CaO(s) + H2O(l) → Ca(OH)2(aq) + Heat

questions.solution: It is a combination reaction (also an exothermic reaction). Calcium oxide reacts vigorously with water to produce slaked lime, releasing a large amount of heat. The balanced equation is CaO(s) + H2O(l) → Ca(OH)2(aq) + Heat.

questions.text: मानव पाचन तंत्र में निम्नलिखित में प्रत्येक की एक भूमिका का उल्लेख कीजिए : (i) हाइड्रोक्लोरिक अम्ल (ii) दीर्घरोम (iii) गुदा अवरोधिनी (iv) लाइपेस
questions.text_english: State one role of each of the following in human digestive system : (i) Hydrochloric acid (ii) Villi (iii) Anal Sphincter (iv) Lipase

key_points: HCl creates acidic medium for pepsin / kills bacteria
Villi increase surface area for absorption
Anal sphincter regulates exit of waste
Lipase digests emulsified fats

questions.solution: (i) Hydrochloric acid creates an acidic medium which facilitates the action of the enzyme pepsin. (ii) Villi increase the surface area for efficient absorption of digested food. (iii) Anal Sphincter regulates the exit of waste material from the body. (iv) Lipase breaks down emulsified fats into fatty acids and glycerol.

sub_questions.text: किसी सुग्राही (छुई मुई) पादप की पत्तियों की गति जड़ों के नीचे की ओर की गति से किस प्रकार भिन्न होती है ?
sub_questions.text_english: How is the movement of leaves of a sensitive plant different from the downward movement of the roots?

key_points: Leaves movement is non-directional (nastic movement)
Root movement is directional (geotropism)

sub_questions.solution: The movement of leaves of a sensitive plant is a nastic movement, which is independent of the direction of the stimulus (touch) and is caused by changes in turgor pressure. The downward movement of roots is geotropism, a directional growth movement in response to gravity.

sub_questions.text: हमारे शरीर में एक हॉर्मोन होता है जो कार्बोहाइड्रेट, प्रोटीन और वसा के उपापचय को नियंत्रित करता है। इस हॉर्मोन और इसे स्रावित करने वाली ग्रंथि के नाम लिखिए। हमारे भोजन में आयोडीन युक्त नमक का होना महत्त्वपूर्ण क्यों है ?
sub_questions.text_english: There is a hormone which regulates carbohydrate, protein and fat metabolism in our body. Name the hormone and the gland which secretes it. Why is it important for us to have iodised salt in our diet?

key_points: Hormone: Thyroxine, Gland: Thyroid
Iodine is essential for thyroxine synthesis

sub_questions.solution: The hormone is Thyroxine, secreted by the Thyroid gland. Iodised salt is important in our diet because iodine is essential for the thyroid gland to synthesize thyroxine. Lack of iodine leads to goitre.

questions.solution: Attempt either sub-question A or B.

questions.text: कोई बिम्ब किसी 15 cm फोकस दूरी के उत्तल दर्पण से 10 cm दूरी पर स्थित है। दर्पण द्वारा बने बिम्ब के प्रतिबिम्ब की स्थिति ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: An object is placed at a distance of 10 cm from a convex mirror of focal length 15 cm. Find the position of the image formed by the mirror.

key_points: u = -10 cm, f = +15 cm
1/v + 1/u = 1/f implies v = +6 cm behind the mirror

questions.solution: Given, object distance u = -10 cm and focal length of convex mirror f = +15 cm. Using mirror formula: 1/v + 1/u = 1/f -> 1/v - 1/10 = 1/15 -> 1/v = 1/15 + 1/10 = 5/30 = 1/6. Therefore, v = +6 cm. The image is formed 6 cm behind the mirror.

sub_questions.text: यह दर्शाइए कि आप तीन प्रतिरोधकों को जिनमें प्रत्येक का प्रतिरोध 6Ω है, किस प्रकार संयोजित करेंगे ताकि संयोजन का प्रतिरोध 9Ω हो। अपने उत्तर की पुष्टि भी कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Show how you would connect three resistors each of resistance 6 Ω, so that the combination has a resistance of 9 Ω. Also justify your answer.

key_points: Two 6 ohm in parallel, one 6 ohm in series with them.
Parallel: 1/Rp = 1/6 + 1/6 = 3 ohms. Total = 3 + 6 = 9 ohms.

sub_questions.solution: To get a total resistance of 9 Ω, connect two 6 Ω resistors in parallel and the third 6 Ω resistor in series with this parallel combination. Justification: Resistance of parallel part Rp = (6 × 6)/(6 + 6) = 3 Ω. Total resistance R = Rp + 6 Ω = 3 Ω + 6 Ω = 9 Ω.

sub_questions.text: दिए गए परिपथ में 2Ω प्रतिरोधक में उपभुक्त शक्ति (वाट में) परिकलित कीजिए :
sub_questions.text_english: In the given circuit calculate the power consumed in watts in the resistor of 2Ω:

key_points: Total Resistance = 1 + 2 = 3 ohms
Current I = V/R = 6/3 = 2 A
Power P = I^2 R = (2)^2 * 2 = 8 W

sub_questions.solution: The 1 Ω and 2 Ω resistors are in series. Total resistance R = 1 Ω + 2 Ω = 3 Ω. The current in the circuit I = V / R = 6 V / 3 Ω = 2 A. The power consumed in the 2 Ω resistor is P = I²R = (2)² × 2 = 4 × 2 = 8 Watts.

questions.text: (i) दो चुम्बकीय क्षेत्र रेखाएं एक दूसरे का प्रतिच्छेदन क्यों नहीं करती हैं ? (ii) किसी दिए गए प्रदेश में एकसमान चुम्बकीय क्षेत्र का निरूपण किस प्रकार किया जाता है ? अपने उत्तर की पुष्टि के लिए आरेख खींचिए।
questions.text_english: (i) Two magnetic field lines do not intersect each other. Why? (ii) How is a uniform magnetic field in a given region represented ? Draw a diagram in support of your answer.

key_points: Intersection would imply two directions of field at one point.
Uniform field is represented by equidistant, parallel straight lines.

questions.solution: (i) Two magnetic field lines never intersect because if they did, the compass needle at the point of intersection would point in two different directions simultaneously, which is impossible. (ii) A uniform magnetic field is represented by a set of equidistant, parallel straight lines pointing in the same direction.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में प्रत्येक की रासायनिक अभिक्रिया के लिए एक-एक रासायनिक समीकरण दीजिए : (i) रंग में परिवर्तन (ii) ताप में परिवर्तन (iii) अवक्षेप का बनना. समीकरण के साथ रंग में परिवर्तन/ ताप में परिवर्तन (बढ़ना/घटना) / अवक्षेपित यौगिक का उल्लेख भी कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Write one chemical equation each for the chemical reaction in which the following have taken place : (i) Change in colour (ii) Change in temperature (iii) Formation of precipitate. Mention colour change/temperature change (rise/fall)/compound precipitated along with equation.

key_points: Fe + CuSO4 → FeSO4 + Cu (Blue to Light Green)
CaO + H2O → Ca(OH)2 + Heat (Rise in temperature)
Na2SO4 + BaCl2 → BaSO4 + 2NaCl (White precipitate of BaSO4)

questions.solution: (i) Change in colour: Fe(s) + CuSO4(aq) → FeSO4(aq) + Cu(s). The blue colour of copper sulphate solution changes to light green iron sulphate. (ii) Change in temperature: CaO(s) + H2O(l) → Ca(OH)2(aq) + Heat. A rise in temperature is observed as it is highly exothermic. (iii) Formation of precipitate: Na2SO4(aq) + BaCl2(aq) → BaSO4(s) + 2NaCl(aq). A white precipitate of Barium sulphate (BaSO4) is formed.

questions.text: (i) टमाटर के जूस के किसी नमूने का pH 4.6 है। इस जूस का स्वाद कैसा होना चाहिए ? अपने उत्तर का कारण दीजिए। (ii) हम किसी प्रबल अम्ल और दुर्बल क्षारक के बीच विभेदन जलीय विलयनों में आयन बनने के पदों में किस प्रकार करते हैं ? (iii) अम्लीय वर्षा का जल जलीय जन्तुओं की उत्तर-जीविता को कठिन बना देता है। ऐसा किस प्रकार होता है ?
questions.text_english: (i) The pH of a sample of tomato juice is 4.6. How is this juice likely to be in taste ? Give reason to justify your answer. (ii) How do we differentiate between a strong acid and a weak base in terms of ion-formation in aqueous solutions ? (iii) The acid rain can make the survival of aquatic animals difficult. How?

key_points: Sour taste because pH < 7 means acidic
Strong acid fully dissociates into H+; weak base partially dissociates into OH-
Lowers pH of river water, harmful to aquatic life

questions.solution: (i) The juice is likely to be sour in taste because its pH is 4.6 (less than 7), which indicates it is acidic in nature. (ii) A strong acid completely ionizes in aqueous solution to produce a large amount of H+ ions, whereas a weak base only partially ionizes to produce a small amount of OH- ions. (iii) When acid rain flows into rivers, it lowers the pH of the river water, making it highly acidic and making the survival of aquatic life difficult.

questions.text: (i) बड़े साइज के शरीर वाले बहुकोशिक जीवों को श्वसन वर्णक की आवश्यकता क्यों होती है ? (ii) निम्नलिखित के लिए कारण दीजिए : (a) कंठ में उपास्थियों के वलय उपस्थित होते हैं। (b) फुफ्फुसों में सदैव वायु का अवशिष्ट आयतन रहता है। (c) जब हम श्वास लेते हैं तो हमारी पसलियाँ ऊपर उठती हैं और डायफ्राम चपटा हो जाता है। (d) कूपिकाओं की भित्ति में रुधिर वाहिकाओं का विस्तीर्ण जाल होता है।
questions.text_english: (i) Why is respiratory pigment needed in multicellular organisms with large body size ? (ii) Give reasons for the following: (a) Rings of cartilage are present in the throat. (b) Lungs always contain a residual volume of air. (c) The diaphragm flattens and ribs are lifted up when we breathe in. (d) Walls of alveoli contain an extensive network of blood vessels.

key_points: Diffusion is insufficient for large distances
(a) Prevents collapse of trachea
(b) Allows continuous oxygen absorption
(c) Increases chest cavity volume
(d) Maximizes gas exchange

questions.solution: (i) In large multicellular organisms, diffusion alone cannot deliver oxygen quickly to all body parts. Respiratory pigments (like haemoglobin) bind to oxygen and transport it efficiently. (ii) (a) Rings of cartilage ensure the air passage does not collapse. (b) Residual volume ensures there is sufficient time for oxygen to be absorbed and carbon dioxide released between breaths. (c) This action increases the volume of the chest cavity, lowering pressure so air rushes into the lungs. (d) The extensive network provides a large surface area for rapid and efficient exchange of gases between alveoli and blood.

questions.text: प्रतिवर्ती क्रिया की परिभाषा लिखिए। प्रवाह आरेख की सहायता से छींकने जैसी प्रतिवर्ती क्रिया का पथ दर्शाइए।
questions.text_english: Define reflex action. With the help of a flow chart show the path of a reflex action such as sneezing.

key_points: Sudden, involuntary response to a stimulus
Receptor → Sensory Neuron → Spinal Cord/Brain stem → Motor Neuron → Effector (Muscle)

questions.solution: Reflex action is a sudden, involuntary, and automatic response of the body to a specific stimulus without conscious thought. Flow chart for sneezing: Irritant in nasal passage (Stimulus) → Receptors in nose → Sensory neuron → Brain stem (Relay neuron) → Motor neuron → Effector muscles (diaphragm and chest muscles) → Sneezing (Response).

questions.text: (i) इस आरेख द्वारा निरूपित दृष्टिदोष का नाम लिखिए। अपने उत्तर के लिए कारण दीजिए। (ii) इस दोष के दो कारणों की सूची बनाइए। (iii) आरेख की सहायता से यह दर्शाइए कि इस दृष्टिदोष का संशोधन किस प्रकार किया जाता है ?
questions.text_english: (i) Name the defect of vision represented in the diagram. Give reason for your answer. (ii) List two causes of this defect. (iii) With the help of a diagram show how this defect of vision is corrected.

key_points: Myopia, image formed in front of retina
Elongation of eyeball, excessive curvature of eye lens
Use a concave lens

questions.image_description: Diagram showing light rays from a distant object converging in front of the retina of a human eye.
questions.solution: (i) The defect is Myopia (nearsightedness). Reason: The diagram shows the image of a distant object being formed in front of the retina instead of on it. (ii) Causes: Excessive curvature of the eye lens or elongation of the eyeball. (iii) Correction: It is corrected using a concave lens of suitable power, which diverges the incoming parallel rays before they enter the eye, allowing the eye lens to focus them exactly on the retina. (Requires diagram of concave lens correction).

questions.text: निम्नलिखित की दिशा को निर्धारित करने वाले नियम का नाम और नियम लिखिए : (i) किसी धारावाही सीधे चालक के चारों ओर उत्पन्न चुम्बकीय क्षेत्र की दिशा। (ii) किसी चुम्बकीय क्षेत्र में क्षेत्र के लम्बवत् स्थित धारावाही सीधे चालक पर आरोपित बल की दिशा।
questions.text_english: Name and state the rule to determine the direction of a: (i) magnetic field produced around a current carrying straight conductor. (ii) force experienced by a current carrying straight conductor placed in a magnetic field which is perpendicular to it.

key_points: Right-Hand Thumb Rule
Fleming's Left-Hand Rule

questions.solution: (i) Right-Hand Thumb Rule: Imagine holding the current-carrying straight conductor in your right hand such that the thumb points towards the direction of current. Then your fingers will wrap around the conductor in the direction of the field lines of the magnetic field. (ii) Fleming's Left-Hand Rule: Stretch the thumb, forefinger, and middle finger of your left hand such that they are mutually perpendicular. If the forefinger points in the direction of magnetic field and the middle finger in the direction of current, then the thumb points in the direction of motion or the force acting on the conductor.

sub_questions.text: पादप → हरिण (मृग) → शेर. उपरोक्त आहार श्रृंखला में दूसरे पोषी स्तर के सभी जीवों को हटाने का प्रभाव पहले और तीसरे पोषी स्तर पर क्या होगा? यदि तीसरे पोषी स्तर के सभी जीव आहार-जाल में उपस्थित होते तो उन पर क्या यही प्रभाव होता जो उपरोक्त आहार श्रृंखला में हुआ है? पुष्टि करें।
sub_questions.text_english: Plants → Deer → Lion. In the given food chain, what will be the impact of removing all the organisms of second trophic level on the first and third trophic level? Will the impact be the same for the organisms of the third trophic level in the above food chain if they were present in a food web? Justify.

key_points: First level increases, third level dies/decreases
In a food web, lions can eat other prey

sub_questions.solution: If all deer (second trophic level) are removed, the plant population (first level) will increase exponentially due to lack of predation. The lion population (third level) will starve and drastically decrease or die out. If lions were in a food web, the impact would be less severe because they could consume alternative prey, ensuring their survival.

sub_questions.text: कोई गैस 'X' जो एक घातक विष है, वायुमण्डल के ऊपरी स्तर में पायी जाती है और एक आवश्यक प्रकार्य का संपादन करती है। इस गैस का नाम और वायुमण्डल में इस गैस के प्रकार्य का उल्लेख कीजिए। इस गैस के स्तर के घटने से किस रसायन का नाम जुड़ा है? इस गैस की परत की क्षति को रोकने के लिए किसी अन्तर्राष्ट्रीय संगठन द्वारा क्या कदम उठाए गए हैं?
sub_questions.text_english: A gas 'X' which is a deadly poison is found at the higher levels of atmosphere and performs an essential function. Name the gas and write the function performed by this gas in the atmosphere. Which chemical is linked to the decrease in the level of this gas? What measures have been taken by an international organization to check the depletion of the layer containing this gas?

key_points: Ozone (O3), absorbs UV rays
CFCs (Chlorofluorocarbons)
UNEP drafted an agreement to freeze CFC production

sub_questions.solution: Gas 'X' is Ozone (O3). In the upper atmosphere, it forms a protective layer that shields the Earth by absorbing harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation from the Sun. Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) are the chemicals linked to its depletion. To check this, the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) forged an agreement (Montreal Protocol) to freeze CFC production worldwide at 1986 levels.

(iii) किसी समजातीय श्रेणी के यौगिकों के रासायनिक गुणधर्मों में क्रमबद्धता क्यों दृष्टिगोचर नहीं होती है ? (iv) आण्विक सूत्र C3H6O के (i) ऐल्डिहाइड और (ii) कीटोन का नाम और संरचना लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (i) Define a homologous series of carbon compounds. (ii) Why is the melting and boiling points of C4H8 higher than that of C3H6 or C2H4? (iii) Why do we NOT see any gradation in chemical properties of a homologous series compounds ? (iv) Write the name and structures of (i) aldehyde and (ii) ketone with molecular formula C3H6O.

key_points: Series with same functional group, differs by CH2
Higher molecular mass implies stronger intermolecular forces
Chemical properties depend solely on the functional group
Propanal and Propanone structures

sub_questions.solution: (i) A homologous series is a series of carbon compounds that have the same functional group and similar chemical properties, in which successive members differ by a -CH2 unit. (ii) The melting and boiling points increase with increasing molecular mass. C4H8 has a higher molecular mass than C3H6 and C2H4, resulting in stronger intermolecular forces. (iii) We do not see gradation in chemical properties because they are determined entirely by the functional group, which remains identical across the series. (iv) For C3H6O: The aldehyde is Propanal (CH3CH2CHO) and the ketone is Propanone (CH3COCH3).

sub_questions.text: (i) उस कार्बन के यौगिक 'X' का नाम और संरचना लिखिए जिसके अणु में दो कार्बन परमाणु हैं और जिसके साथ अनुलग्न '-ol' जुड़ा है। (ii) क्या होता है जब 'X' को आधिक्य सांद्र सल्फ्यूरिक अम्ल के साथ 443K पर गरम किया जाता है? सभी आवश्यक शर्तों को दर्शाते हुए अभिक्रिया का रासायनिक समीकरण लिखिए तथा इस अभिक्रिया में सांद्र सल्फ्यूरिक अम्ल की भूमिका का उल्लेख भी कीजिए। (iii) उपरोक्त अभिक्रिया में बनने वाले हाइड्रोकार्बन का नाम और उसकी इलेक्ट्रॉन-बिन्दु संरचना लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (i) Write the name and structure of an organic compound 'X' having two carbon atoms in its molecule and its name is suffixed with '-ol'. (ii) What happens when 'X' is heated with excess concentrated sulphuric acid at 443 K? Write chemical equation for the reaction stating the conditions for the reaction. Also state the role played by concentrated sulphuric acid in the reaction. (iii) Name and draw the electron dot structure of hydrocarbon produced in the above reaction.

key_points: Ethanol (CH3CH2OH)
Dehydration to Ethene
Sulphuric acid acts as dehydrating agent
Ethene electron dot structure

sub_questions.solution: (i) The compound 'X' is Ethanol. Its structure is CH3-CH2-OH. (ii) When ethanol is heated with excess concentrated sulphuric acid at 443 K, it undergoes dehydration to form ethene. The chemical equation is: CH3CH2OH --(conc. H2SO4, 443K)--> CH2=CH2 + H2O. Concentrated sulphuric acid acts as a dehydrating agent, removing water from ethanol. (iii) The hydrocarbon produced is Ethene. Its electron dot structure consists of a double covalent bond (four shared electrons) between the two carbon atoms, and single bonds between carbons and hydrogens.

sub_questions.text: (i) मानव मादाओं के गर्भधारण को रोकने के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली तीन तकनीकों/युक्तियों के नाम लिखिए। प्रत्येक के विपरीत प्रभाव का उल्लेख कीजिए। (ii) क्या होगा यदि किसी मानव मादा में (a) निषेचन होता है, (b) अण्ड का निषेचन नहीं होता है ?
sub_questions.text_english: (i) Name three techniques/devices used by human females to avoid pregnancy. Mention the side effects caused by each. (ii) What will happen if in a human female (a) fertilisation takes place, (b) an egg is not fertilised ?

key_points: Oral pills (hormonal imbalance), Copper-T (irritation/bleeding), Surgical tubectomy (infection)
(a) Zygote implants in uterus, pregnancy begins
(b) Menstruation occurs

sub_questions.solution: (i) Three techniques: 1. Oral Contraceptive Pills (change hormonal balance, side effect: nausea or hormonal disruption). 2. Intra-Uterine Devices like Copper-T (placed in uterus, side effect: irritation or bleeding). 3. Surgical method / Tubectomy (blocking fallopian tubes, side effect: risk of surgical infections). (ii) (a) If fertilisation occurs, a zygote is formed which divides to form an embryo, implants in the uterine lining, and pregnancy develops. (b) If the egg is not fertilised, the thickened inner lining of the uterus is not needed and breaks down, resulting in menstruation.

sub_questions.text: (i) राइजोपस में बीजाणु समासंघ को आरेख खींचकर दर्शाइए तथा उन भागों को नामांकित कीजिए (a) जो जनन के भाग हैं और (b) जो जनन के भाग नहीं हैं। राइजोपस शुष्क रोटी के टुकड़े पर विकसित क्यों नहीं होते हैं ? (ii) उस विधि का नाम और व्याख्या कीजिए जिसके द्वारा हाइड्रा जनन करता है।
sub_questions.text_english: (i) Draw a diagram showing spore formation in Rhizopus and label the (a) reproductive and (b) non-reproductive parts. Why does Rhizopus not multiply on a dry slice of bread? (ii) Name and explain the process by which reproduction takes place in Hydra.

key_points: Diagram of Sporangium (reproductive) and Hyphae (non-reproductive)
Moisture is essential for spore germination
Budding in Hydra

sub_questions.solution: (i) (Requires Diagram) The reproductive parts are the sporangia containing spores, and the non-reproductive parts are the thread-like hyphae. Rhizopus does not multiply on dry bread because spores require moisture to germinate and grow. (ii) Hydra reproduces by a process called Budding. In this process, a bud develops as an outgrowth due to repeated cell division at a specific site. These buds develop into tiny individuals and, when fully mature, detach from the parent body to become new independent individuals.

sub_questions.text: (i) विद्युत शक्ति की परिभाषा लिखिए। इसे विभवान्तर (V) और प्रतिरोध (R) के पदों में व्यक्त कीजिए। (ii) किसी विद्युत भट्टी की अभिकल्पना उसे 220 V के मेन्स पर कार्य करने के लिए की गयी है। यह भट्टी 5 घन्टे में 11 यूनिट विद्युत ऊर्जा उपभुक्त करती है। परिकलित कीजिए : (a) भट्टी का शक्ति-अनुमतांक (b) भट्टी द्वारा ली जाने वाली विद्युत धारा (c) भट्टी का प्रतिरोध जब वह लाल तप्त है
sub_questions.text_english: (i) Define electric power. Express it in terms of potential difference (V) and resistance (R). (ii) An electric oven is designed to work on the mains voltage of 220 V. This oven consumes 11 units of electrical energy in 5 hours. Calculate: (a) power rating of the oven (b) current drawn by the oven (c) resistance of the oven when it is red hot

key_points: Power is rate of doing work. P = V^2 / R
Energy = 11 kWh, Time = 5 h, Power = 2.2 kW
Current I = P/V = 10 A
Resistance R = V/I = 22 ohms

sub_questions.solution: (i) Electric power is the rate at which electrical energy is dissipated or consumed in an electric circuit. In terms of V and R, it is expressed as P = V²/R. (ii) Given: Energy E = 11 units = 11 kWh, Time t = 5 h, V = 220 V. (a) Power P = E/t = 11 kWh / 5 h = 2.2 kW = 2200 W. (b) Current drawn I = P/V = 2200 W / 220 V = 10 A. (c) Resistance R = V/I = 220 V / 10 A = 22 Ω.

sub_questions.text: (i) किसी बेलनाकार धात्विक सिलिण्डर जिसकी लम्बाई l तथा अनुप्रस्थ काट क्षेत्रफल A है, के प्रतिरोध R और उसके पदार्थ की वैद्युत प्रतिरोधकता के बीच संबंध लिखिए। इस प्रकार वैद्युत प्रतिरोधकता का SI मात्रक व्युत्पन्न कीजिए। (ii) 3 m लम्बाई और 4×10^-7 m² अनुप्रस्थ काट क्षेत्रफल के किसी तार का प्रतिरोध 60 Ω है। इस तार की वैद्युत प्रतिरोधकता परिकलित कीजिए। (iii) यदि इस तार (भाग 'ii') को खींचकर इसकी लम्बाई दोगुनी कर दी जाए तो इसकी वैद्युत प्रतिरोधकता किस प्रकार प्रभावित होगी? अपने उत्तर की पुष्टि कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (i) Write the relation between resistance R and electrical resistivity ρ of the material of a conductor in the shape of cylinder of length l and area of cross-section A. Hence derive the SI unit of electrical resistivity. (ii) The resistance of a metal wire of length 3 m is 60 Ω. If the area of cross-section of the wire is 4×10^-7 m², calculate the electrical resistivity of the wire. (iii) State how would electrical resistivity be affected if the wire (of part 'ii') is stretched so that its length is doubled. Justify your answer.

key_points: R = ρ (l/A), Unit is ohm-meter
Resistivity remains unchanged as it depends only on material and temperature

sub_questions.solution: (i) The relation is R = ρ (l/A). Therefore, ρ = (R × A) / l. The SI unit of R is Ω, area is m², and length is m. So, Unit of ρ = (Ω × m²) / m = Ω·m (ohm-meter). (ii) Given: l = 3 m, R = 60 Ω, A = 4×10⁻⁷ m². Resistivity ρ = (R × A) / l = (60 × 4×10⁻⁷) / 3 = 20 × 4×10⁻⁷ = 8 × 10⁻⁶ Ω·m. (iii) If the wire is stretched to double its length, its electrical resistivity will remain completely unaffected. Justification: Resistivity is a characteristic property of the material of the conductor and depends only on the nature of material and temperature, not on its physical dimensions (length or area).

questions.text: अपचयन की विभिन्न प्रक्रियाओं द्वारा उत्पन्न धातुएं बहुत शुद्ध नहीं होती हैं। इनमें अशुद्धियाँ होती हैं। शुद्ध धातुएं प्राप्त करने के लिए इन अशुद्धियों को दूर किया जाता है। धातुओं को शुद्ध करने की सबसे अधिक प्रचलित विधि विद्युत अपघटनी परिष्करण है।
questions.text_english: The metals produced by various reduction processes are not very pure. They contain impurities, which must be removed to obtain pure metals. The most widely used method for refining impure metals is electrolytic refining.

sub_questions.text: इस प्रक्रिया द्वारा कॉपर के परिष्करण के लिए कैथोड और ऐनोड किसके बने होते हैं?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the cathode and anode made of in the refining of copper by this process?

key_points: Cathode: thin strip of pure copper
Anode: block of impure copper

sub_questions.solution: In the electrolytic refining of copper, the cathode is made of a thin strip of pure copper, and the anode is made of a thick block of impure copper.

sub_questions.text: उपरोक्त प्रक्रिया में उपयोग किए जाने वाले विलयन का नाम और उसका सूत्र लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Name the solution used in the above process and write its formula.

key_points: Acidified Copper Sulphate solution
CuSO4

sub_questions.solution: The solution used is an acidified copper sulphate solution, and its formula is CuSO4.

sub_questions.text: (A) जब इस विद्युत अपघटनी सेल में विद्युत धारा प्रवाहित की जाती है तो कॉपर का परिष्करण किस प्रकार हो जाता है? अथवा (B) आपके पास दो बीकरों 'A' और 'B' में कॉपर सल्फेट विलयन भरा है। यदि आप बीकर 'A' में जिंक की पत्री और बीकर 'B' में सिल्वर की पत्री डुबो दें तो लगभग दो घन्टे के पश्चात् आप क्या प्रेक्षण करेंगे। प्रत्येक प्रकरण के प्रेक्षण का कारण दीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (A) How copper gets refined when electric current is passed in the electrolytic cell? OR (B) You have two beakers 'A' and 'B' containing copper sulphate solution. What would you observe after about 2 hours if you dip a strip of zinc in beaker 'A' and a strip of silver in beaker 'B'? Give reason for your observations in each case.

key_points: (A) Pure Cu dissolves from anode to electrolyte, equivalent pure Cu deposits on cathode
(B) Beaker A: blue color fades, brown deposit (Zn is more reactive). Beaker B: no change (Ag is less reactive)

sub_questions.solution:
Attempting (A): On passing electric current, pure copper from the impure anode dissolves into the electrolyte. An equivalent amount of pure copper from the electrolyte is deposited on the cathode, thus refining the copper. Soluble impurities go into solution while insoluble ones settle at the bottom as anode mud. 
Attempting (B): In beaker 'A', the blue colour of the solution will fade and a reddish-brown deposit of copper forms on the zinc strip, because zinc is more reactive than copper and displaces it. In beaker 'B', there will be no change because silver is less reactive than copper and cannot displace it.

questions.text: मेंडल ने मटर के दिखाई देने वाले कई विपर्यासी लक्षणों का उपयोग करके आनुवंशिकता के नियमों पर कार्य किया। उन्होंने मटर के पौधों के एक अथवा दो विपर्यासी लक्षणों के युग्मों के साथ संकरण कराकर कई प्रयोग किए। अपने प्रेक्षणों के आधार पर उन्होंने कुछ व्याख्याएं कीं जिन्होंने आनुवंशिकता की क्रियाविधि के अध्ययन में सहायता की।
questions.text_english: Mendel worked out the rules of heredity by working on garden pea using a number of visible contrasting characters. He conducted several experiments by making a cross with one or two pairs of contrasting characters of pea plant. On the basis of his observations he gave some interpretations which helped to study the mechanism of inheritance.

sub_questions.text: जब मेंडल ने F1 संतति प्राप्त करने के लिए मटर के शुद्ध लम्बे और शुद्ध बौने लक्षणों वाले पौधों के बीच संकरण कराया तो F1 संतति के पौधों में उन्होंने कौनसे दो प्रेक्षण किए?
sub_questions.text_english: When Mendel crossed pea plants with pure tall and pure short characteristics to produce F1 progeny, which two observations were made by him in F1 plants?

key_points: All F1 plants were tall.
No medium height plants were observed.

sub_questions.solution: Mendel observed that (1) all the F1 plants were tall, and (2) there were no half-way characteristics, meaning no plants of medium height were produced.

sub_questions.text: प्रभावी और अप्रभावी लक्षणों के बीच एक अन्तर लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Write one difference between dominant and recessive trait.

key_points: Dominant trait expresses itself in both homozygous and heterozygous conditions.
Recessive expresses only in homozygous condition.

sub_questions.solution: A dominant trait expresses itself even in the presence of an alternative allele (heterozygous condition), whereas a recessive trait expresses itself only when present in a homozygous condition (both alleles are same).

sub_questions.text: (A) विपर्यासी लक्षणों के दो युग्मों के किसी संकरण में RRYY x rryy (गोल पीले) (झुर्रीदार हरे). मेंडल ने F2 संतति में 4 प्रकार के संयोजनों का प्रेक्षण किया। किस विधि द्वारा उन्होंने F2 संतति के पौधे प्राप्त किए थे? प्राप्त जनकीय संयोजनों का अनुपात लिखिए तथा उल्लेख कीजिए कि इस प्रयोग से क्या निष्कर्ष निकलता है। अथवा (B) इस कथन की पुष्टि कीजिए : यह संभव है कि कोई लक्षण वंशानुगत तो हो जाए परन्तु व्यक्त न हो पाए।
sub_questions.text_english: (A) In a cross with two pairs of contrasting characters RRYY x rryy (Round Yellow) (Wrinkled Green). Mendel observed 4 types of combinations in F2 generation. By which method did he obtain F2 generation? Write the ratio of the parental combinations obtained and what conclusions were drawn from this experiment. OR (B) Justify the statement: It is possible that a trait is inherited but may not be expressed.

key_points: (A) Self pollination of F1. Parental ratio is 9:1 (Round yellow:Wrinkled green). Law of Independent Assortment.
(B) In heterozygous condition, recessive gene is inherited but masked by dominant gene.

sub_questions.solution:
Attempting (A): Mendel obtained F2 generation by self-pollinating the F1 plants. The ratio of the parental combinations obtained (Round Yellow : Wrinkled Green) is 9:1. The conclusion drawn is the Law of Independent Assortment, which states that traits for different characters inherit independently of each other. 
Attempting (B): The statement is justified because an organism might carry a recessive allele for a trait. Due to the presence of a dominant allele (heterozygous condition), the recessive trait is hidden and not physically expressed, even though it is inherited and can be passed to the next generation.

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए आँकड़ों का अध्ययन कीजिए जिनमें तीन अवतल दर्पणों A, B और C की फोकस दूरी तथा उनके सामने स्थित बिम्ब की सापेक्ष दूरी दी गयी है : [Table of values in PDF]
questions.text_english:
Study the data given below showing the focal length of three concave mirrors A, B and C and the respective distances of objects placed in front of the mirrors: 

Case | Mirror | Focal Length (cm) | Object Distance (cm)
1 | A | 20 | 45
2 | B | 15 | 30
3 | C | 30 | 20

sub_questions.text: उपरोक्त प्रकरणों में से किसमें दर्पण द्वारा बने प्रतिबिम्ब का साइज बिम्ब के साइज से छोटा होगा? अपने उत्तर की पुष्टि कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: In which one of the above cases the mirror will form a diminished image of the object? Justify your answer.

key_points: Case 1 (Mirror A)
Object is placed beyond C (distance > 2f)

sub_questions.solution: Case 1 will form a diminished image. Justification: In Case 1, focal length is 20 cm, so the centre of curvature (C) is at 40 cm. Since object distance (45 cm) is greater than 2f (beyond C), a concave mirror forms a real, inverted, and diminished image.

sub_questions.text: प्रकरण 2 में बने प्रतिबिम्ब के दो गुणों की सूची बनाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: List two properties of the image formed in case 2.

key_points: Real and inverted
Same size as the object

sub_questions.solution: In Case 2, the object is at 30 cm, which is exactly at the centre of curvature (C) since f=15 cm. Two properties of the image are: (1) Real and inverted. (2) Same size as the object.

sub_questions.text: (A) दर्पण C द्वारा बने प्रतिबिम्ब की प्रकृति और साइज क्या है? अपने उत्तर की पुष्टि के लिए किरण आरेख खींचिए। अथवा (B) कोई बिम्ब 12 cm फोकस दूरी के अवतल दर्पण के ध्रुव से 18 cm की दूरी पर स्थित है। इस प्रकरण में प्रतिबिम्ब की स्थिति ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (A) What is the nature and size of the image formed by mirror C? Draw ray diagram to justify your answer. OR (B) An object is placed at a distance of 18 cm from the pole of a concave mirror of focal length 12 cm. Find the position of the image formed in this case.

key_points: (A) Virtual, erect, and magnified. Ray diagram required.
(B) v = -36 cm, formed 36 cm in front of mirror.

sub_questions.solution:
Attempting (A): In Case 3, the object distance (20 cm) is less than the focal length (30 cm). The object is between the pole and principal focus. Therefore, the image formed is virtual, erect, and magnified. (Requires diagram). 
Attempting (B): Given u = -18 cm, f = -12 cm. Using mirror formula: 1/v + 1/u = 1/f -> 1/v - 1/18 = -1/12 -> 1/v = 1/18 - 1/12 = (2 - 3)/36 = -1/36. Therefore, v = -36 cm. The image is formed 36 cm in front of the concave mirror.
